Ana (CSM): FYI were seeing elevated p99 and a handful of UI complaints from Jins team at SpringGrid during their morning batch. Baseline ~280ms -> spikes ~720ms. Theyre on hosted, mostly 150-300 token prompts but some workflows chain 800-1200 tokens. Proposing a staged perf plan: 1) traffic-split canary to a quantized model for intake only, 2) short prefix warm-up job before 9am, 3) route fallback to canonical model on errors. Agree?
Dev (Solutions Eng): Sounds good. Would prefer a two-step canary: 5% internal synthetic then 15% customer traffic if metrics look ok. Also suggest a light model swap for very long sequences: route sequences >512 tokens to fp16 variant to avoid quality regression.
Jin (Customer): Thanks Ana. Important we dont impact billing flows. Intake forms and doc parsing are ok to route. The long-chained conversation generator must stay on current model.
Ravi (Edge Ops): We can add an L7 routing rule based on an incoming header and token-length hint. Example rule I propose:```json
{"match":"header('x-springgrid-route') == 'intake' && request.tokens <= 512","variant":"rw-llama-13b-int8-2026v1","weight":0.10}```
Also will schedule a warmup job that hits the model with the top 20 prefixes 10 minutes before peak.
Nora (Onboard PM): Can we attach a light QA harness that runs 100 golden prompts every 6 hours and fails fast if semantic drift >2%? That way we can rollback automatically. Also I'll book a 20-min readiness sync with SpringGrid tomorrow.
Dev (Solutions Eng): Ill prepare the quant profile and an eval runner. Note: int8 gives ~35% compute reduction usually, but for sequences near 1k tokens FP variant still better for latency. My rollout plan: internal 5% for 6h -> customer 15% for 48h -> monitor. Auto-revert triggers: error rate +0.5% or QA delta >2% or p99 >+150ms.
Ana (CSM): Can you surface a cost delta estimate we can share with procurement? Jin, finance will want to see savings vs any potential risk.
Jin (Customer): Finance wants a conservative number. If you can show expected % savings and a worst-case scenario that reverts without user impact we can sign off.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: springgrid-int8-split -> 2026-04-02T14:00Z, initial 5% internal, monitoring hooks: latency, errors, semantic-qa.
Ravi (Edge Ops): I'll attach the routing config to the canary and enable immediate rollback.
Dev (Solutions Eng): Putting draft route + warmup snippet in the playbook now. Also recommending prefix-cache TTL=45s for repeated system prompt to cut KV lookups.
Ana (CSM): Action items: SE to push route/quant + cost estimate, Ops to run warmup and enable auto-revert, Onboard PM to schedule customer sync, CSM to share eval set and notify finance. Will post canary updates here every 6 hours while active.
Jin (Customer): Thanks team, appreciate the careful canary. Well have our monitoring team watch and will join the sync.
Ana (CSM): Noted. Priority: no user-facing regressions; revert immediately on any sign of semantic regression or error spike.
Dev (Solutions Eng): Quick snippet for route rule we're using in infra config:
```yaml
- name: springgrid-intake-int8
  match: "header('x-springgrid-route') == 'intake' && request.tokens <= 512"
  variant: rw-llama-13b-int8-2026v1
  weight: 0.10
```
Ravi (Edge Ops): Warmup cron: `0 8 * * *` hits top prefixes with concurrency=4 for 5 minutes.
ops-bot: Canary started: 2026-04-02T14:00Z -> reporting every 6h.
Ana (CSM): Thanks all, will loop back after first 12h window with latency and QA snapshots.
